Cinema 4D

Cinema 4D supports motion design, 3D modelling, simulation and rendering.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Create a motion-design scene

Use the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended Cinema 4D preview, create a motion-design scene; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Animate procedural elements

Start from the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended Cinema 4D preview, animate procedural elements; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Render a final composition

Begin with the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended Cinema 4D preview, render a final composition; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
